About Me

I build brands, events and partnerships.

I handle marketing end to end: brand building, co-branding, social media, Meta campaigns and graphic design in Canva. I also plan and run events for doctors, clients, partners and staff, handling everything from the first plan to the final day.

I create video content from idea to post, editing in DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, VN and CapCut. Alongside marketing, I have built a healthcare partner network of 130+ providers and a distribution network of around 150 centres across the Northern Emirates.
